description: National Public Data Portal is an open data portal listed in National Public Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Nemzeti Adatvagyon Ügynökség Korlátolt Felelősségű Társaság. The National Public Data Portal collects and publishes on a single platform a list of registers and databases containing data of public interest and public data held by public organisations, the Public Data Catalogue. This register is available and accessible free of charge to all interested parties. Coverage: Hungary. The European data portal lists 2,283 datasets from this catalogue. A multilingual title search (26 languages, transport, energy, water, digital and hazard words) found 105 datasets about infrastructure or natural hazards, catalogued as 19 records (collections of three or more datasets from one publisher or service host, and single datasets); the rest are outside the scope of this catalogue. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-kozadatportal.
